axes_source: Read from data/brands/snap.json: warmth from the hue and chroma of the primary #FFFC00 and the canvas #FFFFFF; contrast from the ink #0C0D10 on that canvas, its depth and the chroma of #FFFC00; density from its 4px spacing base; geometry from its radii 8, 16, 24, 999px; formality from the chroma of its primary and ink; motion from its stated durations 5000ms, 200ms; type personality at 0.5 since neither face is in the engine's catalog.
brand_rule: The primary #FFFC00 reaches only 1.10:1 on the canvas #FFFFFF and no accent reaches 3:1, so the primary stays and the engine derives the action color from it.
